CREATE TABLE `fp02_form_leads` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  `form_key` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `form_context` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `source_url` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `source_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `source_post_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `visitor_name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `phone` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `email` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci,
  `delivery_status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `smtp_status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `metrika_goal` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `utm_source` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `utm_medium` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `utm_campaign` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `utm_content` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `utm_term` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `referrer` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `ua_class` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `error_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `attempt_count` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `is_qa` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `created_at` (`created_at`),
  KEY `form_key` (`form_key`),
  KEY `delivery_status` (`delivery_status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci
